C1839.title: Jiaozhou Cracks National Online Freight-Platform Fraud Case, Eight Sentenced
C1839.summary: Criminals exploited loopholes in an online freight platform by illegally purchasing driver-side and shipper-side accounts, first impersonating drivers to accept orders, then impersonating shippers to dispatch orders, transporting shippers' cargo to other locations for cheap resale, and defrauding drivers of freight fees when goods couldn't be sold. In November 2024, CCTV reported the case, with Jiaozhou People's Procuratorate revealing this new freight scam. The gang operated nationwide, and eight members were ultimately sentenced for fraud. The case exposes the dual risks of cargo and funds from account trading and identity impersonation on freight platforms.
